description: An acknowledgement whose window holds a long run of received D_PDUs is sent run length encoded, because that is more compact than the bitmap.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept and dts-arq/rx-data-acked: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, recorded Ed4 (B-0408), our accept goes out at 52000 (25 bytes, a whole block, so no fill), and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family, RX LWE 0 (C-0782). At 61000 one burst from the peer, every D_PDU with EOT 20 (end by 71000): FSNs 1 to 70 and 74, so the window from RX LWE + 1 = 1 to RX UWE = 74 (C-0207, C-0209, C-0233) is 70 received, 3 missing, 1 received. FSN 1 is a whole C_PDU 'ping' without DELIVER IN ORDER, so it is delivered at once (C-0179): cas.first_data stops (B-0215) and the SIS hands it to conn 1. Every other D_PDU is a one-byte middle segment (neither C_PDU START nor END), stored and not delivered. FSN 0 never arrives, so RX LWE stays 0 (C-0776) and an acknowledgement is owed (C-0174). The burst ends at 62000: csma.vdcd_end to 71000, LBT rule 1 (K-0067), contention 12000 ms. At 83000 the acknowledgement goes: the bitmap of those 74 bits would take 10 bytes (C-0227), the run length encoding 4 (C-0228 to C-0232): a two-byte code for the 70 ones (value 1, Extended 1, Length 69: C0 45, C-0230, C-0231), a one-byte code for the 3 zeros (value 0, Length 2: 02, C-0229) and one for the last one (value 1, Length 0: 80). The more compact goes (C-0225, C-1150), so one ACK-ONLY (type 10): RX LWE 0, Encoding 1, Offset 0, Ack Length 4, the Ack Data in the header since it is 21 bytes or fewer (C-0195, C-0218, C-0235): 19 bytes, EOT 10. Fill (C-1154): 6 bytes are left in the block, too few for a copy of the ACK-ONLY or a PADDING D_PDU, so they are zero filled. The transmission is 19 bytes, 1 block, and ends at 88550; no data of ours, so no dts.ack_wait. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500) (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its Ack Data in the header form and 19 bytes plus its Ack Data and CRC-32 in the long form, a PADDING D_PDU 11 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
